name: FRKN Bananas

features.name: Spreading Bananas
features.description: Wild multipliers that spread left or up to the edge of the grid.

features.name: Shared multiplier
features.description: Spawned bananas copy the original's multiplier.

features.name: Win-only spreading
features.description: Bananas only spread if it completes a win.

review:
Monkey business with Spreading Banana wilds that point left or up. When one lands, it spreads more bananas to the edge of the grid in that direction – but only if that completes a win. Every banana reveals a multiplier, and the ones it spawns copy it.

The moment to hope for: a single banana on reel 6 pointing left, turning a whole row into multiplier wilds. 10,000x max. Hacksaw doesn't publish an RTP outside the game; the 96.31% we show comes from two independent databases that agree.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: RTP comes from third-party databases, not from Hacksaw
Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
